sources.title: Articles on Smashing Magazine — For Web Designers And Developers

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Ari Stiles)
articles.description: We’ve got exciting news! eBook versions of “Accessible UX Research,” a new Smashing Book by Michele A. Williams, are now available for download! Which means soon the book will go to the printer. Order the eBook for instant download now or reserve your print copy at the presale price.
articles.title: Accessible UX Research, eBook Now Available For Download

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Brecht De Ruyte)
articles.description: CSS Wrapped 2025 is out! We’re entering a world where CSS can increasingly handle logic, state, and complex interactions once reserved for JavaScript. Here is an unpacking of the standout highlights and how they connect to the bigger evolution of modern CSS.
articles.title: State, Logic, And Native Power: CSS Wrapped 2025

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Paul Boag)
articles.description: Lead your organization’s AI strategy before someone else defines it for you. A practical framework for UX professionals to shape AI implementation.
articles.title: How UX Professionals Can Lead AI Strategy

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Victor Yocco)
articles.description: Explainable AI isn’t just a challenge for data scientists. It’s also a design challenge and a core pillar of trustworthy, effective AI products. Victor Yocco offers practical guidance and design patterns for building explainability into real products.
articles.title: Beyond The Black Box: Practical XAI For UX Practitioners

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Patrick Brosset)
articles.description: CSS Masonry is almost here! Patrick Brosset takes a deep dive into what this long-awaited feature means for web developers and how you could make use of it in your own work.
articles.title: Masonry: Things You Won’t Need A Library For Anymore

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Cosima Mielke)
articles.description: With December just around the corner, how about some new desktop wallpapers to welcome the last month of the year — and the holiday season, if you’re celebrating? Our latest edition of monthly wallpapers has got you covered. Enjoy!
articles.title: A Sparkle Of December Magic (2025 Wallpapers Edition)

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Eleanor Hecks)
articles.description: CAPTCHAs were meant to keep bots out, but too often, they lock people with disabilities out, too. From image classification to click-based tests, many “human checks” are anything but inclusive. There’s no universal solution, but understanding real user needs is where accessibility truly starts.
articles.title: The Accessibility Problem With Authentication Methods Like CAPTCHA

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Ari Stiles)
articles.description: We’re so happy to announce that “Maturing Design Systems”—a Smashing book by Ben Callahan — will soon be joining the Smashing Library! Ben’s insights and advice are so powerful, we thought you might like to read an excerpt from the book. Subscribe to our Smashing newsletter to be notified when orders are open.
articles.title: Design System Culture: What It Is And Why It Matters (Excerpt)

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Vitaly Friedman)
articles.description: Practical guidelines on designing time-critical products that prevent errors and improve accuracy. Part of the Measure UX & Design Impact (use the code 🎟 IMPACT to save 20% off today). With a live UX training starting next week.
articles.title: Designing For Stress And Emergency

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Amit Sheen)
articles.description: Animations can be one of the most joyful parts of building interfaces, but without structure, they can also become one of the biggest sources of frustration. By consolidating and standardizing keyframes, you take something that is usually messy and hard to manage and turn it into a clear, predictable system.
articles.title: Keyframes Tokens: Standardizing Animation Across Projects

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Mansoor Ahmed Khan)
articles.description: Server chaos doesn’t have to be the norm. AI-ready infrastructure and automation can bring clarity, performance, and focus back to your web work.
articles.title: From Chaos To Clarity: Simplifying Server Management With AI And Automation

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Godstime Aburu)
articles.description: Debugging controllers can be a real pain. Here’s a deep dive into how CSS helps clean it up and how to build a reusable visual debugger for your own projects.
articles.title: CSS Gamepad API Visual Debugging With CSS Layers
